title: Avoid root account usage
check: Verify CloudTrail logs for root account activity in the last 30 days
remediation: Enable MFA on root account, create IAM users with necessary permissions, use IAM users for daily operations

title: Enable MFA on root account
check: Check if MFA is enabled on the root account
remediation: Enable virtual MFA device or hardware MFA key on root account, store backup codes securely

title: Secure root account access keys
check: Verify that root account has no access keys or old access keys exist
remediation: Delete all root account access keys, use IAM users with temporary credentials instead

title: Ensure MFA enabled for all IAM users
check: Verify all console access users have MFA enabled
remediation: Enable MFA (virtual, hardware, or SMS) for all IAM users with console access

title: Remove unused access keys
check: Identify access keys not used in 90 days
remediation: Delete unused access keys or rotate them, implement access key rotation policy

title: Restrict IAM policy changes
check: Verify CloudTrail has API logging enabled, check for unauthorized policy changes
remediation: Enable CloudTrail, restrict IAM policy changes to authorized principals, review IAM policies regularly

title: Avoid attached inline policies on IAM users
check: Identify IAM users with inline policies attached
remediation: Use managed policies instead of inline policies, centralize policy management

title: Avoid attached inline policies on IAM roles
check: Identify IAM roles with inline policies attached
remediation: Use managed policies instead of inline policies for roles

title: Ensure IAM policies are attached to groups, not users
check: Verify permissions are assigned through groups
remediation: Use IAM groups for policy assignment, add users to groups instead of direct policy attachment

title: Review IAM policy permissions
check: Identify policies with overly permissive permissions (wildcard actions)
remediation: Review and restrict permissions to minimum required, use least privilege principle

title: Enable CloudTrail logging
check: Verify CloudTrail is enabled and logging to S3
remediation: Enable CloudTrail in all regions, ensure logs are immutable and monitored

title: Monitor IAM policy changes
check: Verify CloudWatch alerts are configured for IAM changes
remediation: Create CloudWatch alarms for PutUserPolicy, PutGroupPolicy, PutRolePolicy events
